meta.publisher: New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission
meta.task: binary: tip >= 20% of fare for credit-card yellow taxi trips
meta.label: payment_type == 1 and fare_amount > 0; y = tip_amount >= 0.2 * fare_amount
meta.subsample_rule: load(): per month, card trips sorted by pickup time, every 12th row; then c4_build.N_MAX systematic if above 400k
meta.features_note: pickup hour/dow/month, PULocationID, passenger_count, RatecodeID, VendorID: all known at pickup. Dropoff, fare, tip, distance not used as features.
